script.name: Install Workshop mod
script.description: Moves the Workshop item to @<id>, lowercases its files (required on Linux), copies its keys to keys/ and adds it to the Mods variable (-mod=).

script.name: Uninstall Workshop mod
script.description: Deletes the @<id> folder, removes its keys from keys/ (unless another mod uses them) and removes it from the Mods variable.

metadata.notes: Game imported from plugin TCA.Games.V2.74 version 1.1.0.
